# S8: concise menus and presentation (Opus 5.5 high)

**Branch:** `t3/concise-menu-presentation`, on B1 `2cff245`. The commit list is in `git log 2cff245..HEAD`. Ownership: `src/ui/*`, `src/style.css` and UI tests, plus one display-only change in `src/sim/step.ts` (B1-R1-03, assigned by the coordinator).

## Player outcome
- **Fabrication** shows the next useful work first, as compact rows:
  - each row has a name, have/needed costs and one actionable reason beside a short verb button (Repair, Build, Refit, Fabricate);
  - the reasons are things like "At Home pod · NW · 20 m", "Need 1 Buoyant resin", "Bring 2 Conductive crust" or "Leave the craft to use a bench";
  - bench, refit scope, the exact refusal, quantities not usable here, local sources and known habitats sit behind each row's disclosure;
  - owned craft, locked work (unmet prerequisites) and completed work fold into one row of closed disclosures;
  - each button keeps the full recipe name as its `aria-label`, and the reason as `aria-describedby`.
- **Title menu:**
  - the tagline and the build note are gone;
  - the carrier fixture appears only with `?dev`;
  - Settings opens in place as a two-column view (controls beside the fields, plus save tools), and Esc or Back returns to the main menu;
  - focus moves to Back when settings open and returns to Settings when they close.
- **Cargo:**
  - each craft and the cabin get one status line with their actions on it;
  - Store materials is a single row;
  - Creel mount packages are rows of location plus a short verb ("Swap · hold 40 CU"), with the full action as the accessible name and any refusal on the same line;
  - helper copy is removed ("Unfitted packages stow…", "Meals, cells… stay…", the disabled Deploy buoy, equipment names in the status line).
- **Notebook:**
  - every record stays whole, but only the newest is open;
  - places, habitats, preparation, plans, return and berth fold into a row;
  - the dive check is one line with Hint;
  - the "Personal field notes add context…" line is removed.
- **B1 nits fixed:**
  - R1-01: the cabin's own aft hatch prompts "Leave by hatch".
  - R1-02: cabin, mooring and canister holds have their own labels, using the simulation's label table, and the unknown dark mooring's locker no longer appears under Elsewhere.
  - R1-03: module receipts name the real module and hold ("Creel cargo rack removed · Creel hold").

## Evidence
- **Screenshots:** `~/.local/share/siltwake-evidence/s8/{before,after}/<view>-<size>.png`. There are 21 before and 23 after; the extra two are the expanded fabrication row and the notebook's end.
- **How they were captured:** T3 `preview_snapshot save=true` on port 5193, using one tab, now closed. The game ran inside an exact-size iframe, `.test-build/s8/frame.html`, which is ignored by git.
- **Why the iframe:** this host resets page layout to 1280×800 during a snapshot, so a plain `preview_resize` gives a crop, not a true 960 or 1920 layout.
- **Scenario saves:** `tests/ui-scenarios.ts` builds the states through real paid recipes and the B1 helpers, and every save passes strict save validation.

## Checks
- `npm run typecheck` passes.
- `node --test` on app, presentation, preparation-panels, experience-signals, session-notices, targeting, session, input, expedition-decisions, m2-b1-creel and modules: **286/286 pass**.
- Nothing here uses Babylon, so no heavy-check run was needed.
- **Adverse case** (tested): a seated pilot at the workshop sees "Leave the craft to use a bench", and the Fabricate button stays natively disabled, with that reason as its description.

## Extending panels (S4, S5, S6)
- **Adding a section:** `PanelView.addSection(kind, { id, after, render(state, kit) })` inserts a block after a named built-in section.
  - Notebook anchors: `dive-check`, `question`, `interpretation`, `findings`, `field-notes`, `refuge`, `places`, `habitats`, `preparation`, `plans`, `return`, `berth`.
  - Cargo anchor: `cargo`. Fabricate anchor: `fabricate`. An unknown anchor appends at the end.
- **The kit:** `kit.button` creates commands with focus restore. `kit.group` makes disclosures whose open state persists, namespaced `<panel>:<id>`.
- **Rules for extensions:** one-line rows, one reason per action, and longer help behind `group`.
- **Suggested placement:**
  - S5 interpretations go after `interpretation`.
  - S4 ecology notes go after `habitats`, inside the fold row, where they stretch full width.
  - S6 audio captions belong to the HUD, not panels. Add a caption channel next to `hazard` in `NoticePresenter`, keep it inside `#alert-stack`, and honour the captions setting. `.encounter-stack` keeps that column separate from `#interaction-stack` and `#call-cue`. I didn't change its CSS, but I didn't re-run a live warning capture either.
- **Where to register:** the coordinator calls `addSection` from `GameView`. Wiring it into `app.ts` is left to composition.

## Known limits
- The dev flag is URL-only (`?dev`). The V key opens the carrier panel only inside a fixture session, as before.
- The Cargo panel still lists every container and item when there are many. A filter or tabs would be the next step.
- The long sim refusals above still appear as row reasons for refit, service and mount actions until the registry and simulation copy changes.
- The settings view relies on CSS `:has()`, which Chromium supports.
- The Vite dev server logs Babylon shader-compile errors after dependency re-optimization. They predate this stream, and rendering continued.

## R1 fixes (Sol R1 on `98dcf72`)
- **S8-01:** disclosures remember only the player's departures from each rendered default. The newest notebook record now opens automatically after later finds and after a reload, while records the player opened or closed keep that state. Regression test: "only the newest record opens across later finds and reloads".
- **S8-02:** Creel mount actions restore focus to the `mount:<vehicleId>` row; the Dart trim keeps its `fitting:` fallback. Regression test: "Creel mount changes keep keyboard focus on the mount row".
- **Trailing space:** panel bottom padding is now 16 px (was 48), so the workshop Fabrication view fits without trailing scroll.
- `addSection` is unchanged. **288/288 tests pass.**
